messages:
Asha Mehta: Hi all, first-week hiccup. I'm tethering my laptop to my phone hotspot and the Okta Gateway says connected, route to 10.0.0.0/8 is present, but `ssh ubuntu@10.10.4.2` starts the key exchange and then just stalls during auth. Ping to the bastion works but SCP and SSH hang. Anyone hit this with mobile hotspots?
Tom Barnes: welcome Asha! quick checks: can you paste `netstat -nr` or `ip route` and `ifconfig`/`ip link`? also what's the MTU on the VPN interface? Mobile carriers often change MTU and cause fragmentation issues.
Asha Mehta: here's the redacted route: `10.0.0.0/8 169.254.7.1 UGSc 0 0 tun0` and `default via 100.64.0.1` (cell carrier CGNAT). `ip link show tun0` shows mtu 1500. traceroute shows last hop the VPN gw then nothing for TCP. `ping -s 1400 10.10.4.2` works but `ping -s 1472` fails (frag needed).
Lena Yu: sounds like MTU/fragmentation. Mobile networks (and some hotspots) enforce a low path MTU due to carrier encapsulation. If the VPN tunnel MTU is 1500, large packets may be dropped. Two quick fixes: 1) reduce your VPN/tun MTU locally: `sudo ip link set dev tun0 mtu 1300` (or `sudo ifconfig utun0 mtu 1300` on mac), 2) force lower MSS for TCP: `sudo iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp --tcp-flags SYN,RST SYN -j TCPMSS --set-mss 1200` (linux). Try the MTU change first.
Asha Mehta: tried `sudo ip link set dev tun0 mtu 1300` and then retried ssh -> immediately connected and SFTP works. Nice.
Tom Barnes: great. For completeness: also try `ssh -o IPQoS=throughput` if you see SSH stalls related to DSCP/ECN on some carriers. And if you're on mac, `sudo ifconfig utun0 mtu 1300` works too.
okta-bot: Okta Gateway session refreshed for Asha Mehta. If you change network adapters, please re-auth via browser MFA to ensure route & DNS policies are pushed.
Asha Mehta: re-authed Okta just now. One follow-up: will this MTU tweak persist across reboots or reconnects?
Lena Yu: local MTU change won't persist after a reconnect/reboot. Short-term options: add a small startup script (systemd unit / launchd / NetworkManager dispatcher) to set MTU on the tun device after Okta connects, or avoid tethering during initial onboarding. We're adding a doc note.
infra-bot: Asha Mehta's IAM tag `corp-ssh-access` is pending approval. Infra reviewers: please approve to enable console SSM sessions for her account.
Asha Mehta: filing infra request now. For docs: can we add a one-liner: "If using mobile hotspot, lower VPN MTU (1300) or use Wi‑Fi/headquarters network"? I'll add it to my onboarding notes.
Tom Barnes: yes, we'll add a short troubleshooting bullet to the VPN onboarding: "Mobile hotspots may require MTU/MSS adjustments; if SSH stalls after tunnel establishes, lower tun MTU to ~1300 or apply TCP MSS clamping."
Asha Mehta: confirmed — SSH + scp working now. thanks all :tada:
